title: Complex system presenting restricted cohomology after affine base change
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $I$ a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{op}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ a diagram with affine transitions and qcqs structure morphisms. Let $c$ have limiting underlying scheme cone and qcqs structure morphism. Let $F_i,\phi$ be abelian etale coefficients with the identity and composition HEq laws in the Lean signature, and $H:I\to\mathrm{Sh}(c.pt)$ with isomorphisms $eH_i:H_i\simeq f_i^{-1}F_i$ and canonical transition equation. Fix $p\in\mathbb N$ and an affine etale $U\to S$. The groups $R(g_i,F_i,U,p)$ and $R(g,\operatorname{colim}H,U,p)$ of [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], with the canonical restricted pullback/coefficient maps from $\phi_i=(eH_i)^{-1}\operatorname{colimit}.\iota_i$, admit the following complex-system realization: an $I^{op}$ diagram $D'$ of qcqs schemes with affine maps and a limiting cone $c'$; complexes $K_i$ with coherent inverse-image transitions and zero terms below degree zero; a diagram $G$ of their pullbacks to the limit with isomorphisms $eG_i$ and the canonical transition equation; and a coefficient cocone $L$ with $\mathrm{IsColimit}(L)$. There is a diagram $T$ identified with stage cohomology and a cocone $B$ identified with $H^p(c'.pt,QL.pt)$; their maps and legs are exactly the fixed $P_p=\mathrm{rawAffineComplexPullback}$ followed by the respective coefficient maps. There are isomorphisms from the stage restricted-cohomology groups to $T_i$ and the limit restricted-cohomology group to $B.pt$, intertwining each restricted map with its leg. Every coherence equation is written in the Lean signature. No raw derived-Hom group, raw comparison, cohomology-colimit assertion or representative assertion occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Apply exists_restricted_affine_coefficient_system to obtain the restricted geometric and coefficient complex data, a coefficient colimit cocone L with zero terms below degree zero, and stage/limit cohomology isomorphisms r and rL with the canonical morphism equation.

Package the stage and vertex complexes as bounded-below using hbelow and hbelowL and CochainComplex.isStrictlyGE_iff. Apply rawAffineComplex_system_map_coherence to get identity, composition and cone-leg equations for the fixed canonical maps. Define T on objects by stage complex cohomology and on arrows by rawAffineComplexPullback followed by the coefficient map. The first two equations prove its functor laws. Define B with vertex H^p(c.pt,QL.pt) and legs the projection pullback followed by the coefficient leg; the third equation proves naturality. Set eT and eB to identity isomorphisms. Their required equations follow by simplification. Set restrictionIso_i=r_i and restrictionLimitIso=rL; evaluate the coefficient-system morphism equality at t to obtain the final element equation.

proof_origin.place: Coefficient construction split from formal cohomology diagram and cocone construction; coherence uses the existing bounded-below derived cohomology pullback laws.
